message.content: Based on the conversations between Li Hua and Wolfgang Schulz, they initially discussed visiting a photography exhibition together. Specifically, Wolfgang Schulz expressed interest in attending a photography exhibition scheduled for the following week, which Li Hua confirmed. Wolfgang Schulz suggested a Friday evening as a convenient time for the outing, which Li Hua agreed upon. Therefore, Li Hua and Wolfgang Schulz plan to visit the photography exhibition on Friday evening.
